about_the_game:
This demo is a special test build — not part of the main story.
It focuses purely on the battle system and difficulty balance.
Fight endless waves of enemies, experiment with skills, and test your limits.
There’s no ending — you play until your party falls.

You can adjust the difficulty and discover hidden achievement pop-ups — but they don’t save progress in this version.

Some visual effects, icons, and balancing are still in development.
This demo exists to test the combat experience — not to show story or world design.
